findings.claim: The changed line says landing_commit is the commit that landed the delivery 'on the default branch (the last slice to land when delivered as chained PRs)'. Under the ODD feature-branch-chain delivery strategy, the last slice lands on the feature branch. The commit that lands on the default branch is the later feature-to-main merge. The two halves of the sentence now point to different commits, so a parent following the parenthetical could record the slice merge, which is not on the default branch, as landing_commit. That shifts t1. Before this change the line named no branch, so 'last slice to land' was unambiguous. The living spec (openspec/specs/actuals-instrumentation/spec.md:111 and :118) has the same unresolved pairing, which this commit now copies into the consumed closure contract.
